target.title: Normalize deep link scheme and host
target.body:
Closes #2

## Summary

Fixes case-sensitive deep link dispatch in `AppMain`.

`application(_:open:)` now lowercases both the URL scheme and host before matching, so links such as `Nameplate://config`, `nameplate://Config` and `Nameplate://Settings` are routed correctly instead of being silently ignored.

This keeps AppMain consistent with `ConfigProposal`, which already normalizes scheme and host internally.

## Verification

- `swift build`
- `git diff --check`

Manual runtime proof, using a temporary local proof hook that invoked the real `AppDelegate.application(_:open:)` handler with `Nameplate://Settings` and logged the AppMain dispatch path. The proof hook and logging were removed after the run and are not part of this PR.

Observed output:

```text
PROOF received rawScheme=Nameplate rawHost=Settings
PROOF normalized scheme=nameplate host=settings
PROOF dispatch=settings
```
This shows a mixed-case deep link reaches AppMain with raw mixed-case values, is normalized to scheme=nameplate and host=settings, and dispatches to the settings branch.
